== Biography ==
Jonet was born before 1657. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1149|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Tailyour-5|Eupham Tailyour]]. 
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1149]] is assessed at 37% (possible). Jonet's 1 January 1657 St Cuthbert's index names Robert Glasgow and Eupham Tailyour. A Robert of the 1627 generation could father Jonet in 1657, but Eupham Tailyour is a different recorded mother from the Lorimer children on either side of this date.

Possible at a low level for Robert-1149. The record’s father is named; a simultaneous or differently identified Robert household remains a real alternative. No Lorimer maternity is transferred.

Next useful test: Identify the Tailyour couple independently through marriage, residence and trade records.
